items.finding: The temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solutions in NIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: Temperature variations should be carefully monitored or controlled when measuring aqueous fermentation broths using NIR to avoid spectral shifts caused by water OH band sensitivity.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited text discusses biopharmaceutical downstream processing samples in general laboratory or tempered holders rather than a stainless-steel in-line fermentation pipe.

items.finding: Data-level fusion involves the direct concatenation of multimodal data followed by intelligent learning algorithms, though raw data can contain redundant or noisy signals that might degrade accuracy if not addressed.
items.how_it_applies: When testing low-level data fusion of NIR and Raman spectra, preprocessing should be evaluated to remove noise and redundancies before concatenating the matrices into a unified model input.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: This source discusses multimodal fusion for food safety analyses rather than continuous pipe monitoring of ethanol in fermentation broths.

citation.quote: Data-level fusion is defined as the integration of raw or minimally processed data from multiple modalities at the input layer to construct a unified input representation. In the context of multimodal data fusion, this approach typically involves the direct concatenation of multimodal data, followed by the application of intelligent learning algorithms for downstream computational tasks.
citation.label: E04 ¶15
